Capabilities

Snapshot & Resume

Sandbox sleeps when idle, wakes from snapshot. State persists across cycles.

Secure Sandbox

Firecracker microVMs with network policies. Isolated, ephemeral, zero shared state.

9+ Channels

Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and more. Webhook-driven wake on message.

40+ LLM Providers

OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more.

CLI + Web UI

Terminal for operators. Web dashboard for teams. Same agent, same API.

Pluggable Agents

Abstract agent interface. Swap frameworks without rewriting deployment config.
